newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Danzas has better Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Danzas has better Q1 results.

text.p: Danzas AG chief executive Peter Wagner said group results in the first quarter showed a slight improvement over the same quarter of 1996.
"First quarter results for the entire group were slightly higher than the good results seen in the first quarter of 1996," Wagner said.
He was speaking at the freight forwarding company's annual news briefing.
In addition, chairman Peter Gross said that business slowed in the fourth quarter of 1996, but had picked up again in the first quarter of 1997. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
